The '''Murkwater Shallows''' are a sub-location of the [[Moonglade Marsh]].

== Features ==
The '''Murkwater Shallows''' is the underwater of the {{zone|Murkwater Loch}}. It is meant for {{Skill|Fishing}} and {{Skill|Hunting}}, most notably [[Hunting#Water Hunting|Water Hunts]], and houses several mobs that can be hunted with a [[Fishing Net]].
